author: iFixit
description:
The headline feature on the S26 Ultra, at least for me, isn’t anything related to the annual spec bumps. It’s the screen, a 6.9” AMOLED display equipped with what Samsung calls “Flex Magic Pixels”. That’s the marketing speak for this crazy cool baked-in privacy screen that you can toggle on and off, and even customize to certain popups and apps. 

That’s neat and all, while it works, but what happens if the screen breaks or the battery wears out? Would you be able to fix an S26 Ultra? Let’s find out.
